title: Crispy Ethiopian Mozzarella Quesadillas
description: A unique fusion of Mexican and Ethiopian flavors, these crispy quesadillas are filled with creamy mozzarella and crunchy mozzarella.
instructions: Cut the crispy flatbread into triangles.
In a pan, sprinkle the shredded mozzarella with the nutty Ethiopian spice blend.
Place a flatbread triangle on top of the mozzarella mixture.
Fold the flatbread in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and the flatbread is crispy.
